keywordAudit.quote: This RFC defines the Covenant Declaration Language (CDL), a universal vocabulary for expressing data governance requirements that travel with data across system boundaries. CDL enables AI systems to understand and enforce data handling constraints through natural language declarations attached to JSON Schema at any hierarchical level. This evaluation can be performed deterministically by a policy decision point (PDP) at a proxy tier, or semantically by an LLM, or both in layered defense-in-depth.
